info.description: Canonical collection generated from scripts/generate-postman.js. Covers every controller/security endpoint, with headers, request bodies, query parameters, path variables, chaining scripts, tests and saved response examples. Run folders 01-08 in order with the matching environment and cookie jar enabled. Folder 09 is a response-contract catalogue; its 500 item is documentation-only.
